name: @red-cup-engineering/git-services-section
description: Git service using ActivityStreams, typed RMN task effects, and a separately hireable device I/O provider.

scripts.check: sh -n bin/git && node --check src/bound-git-induction-wire.js && node --check src/bound-git-induction-card-evidence.js && node --check src/bound-git-induction-auth.js && node --check src/bound-git-induction-store.js && node --check src/bound-git-induction-client.js && node --check src/bound-git-induction-production.js && node --check src/bound-git-induction-service.js && node --check src/bound-git-induction-a2a-executor.js && node --check src/serve-bound-git-induction.js && node --check src/collect-colony-activity.mjs && node --check src/settle-filesystem-receipt.mjs && node --check test/fixtures/bound-git-network-receiver.mjs
scripts.test: node --test test/bound-git-induction-wire.test.js test/bound-git-induction-auth.test.js test/bound-git-induction-store.test.js test/bound-git-induction-service.test.js test/bound-git-induction-ingress.test.js test/bound-git-card-evidence-negative.test.js test/bound-git-network-sit.test.js test/bound-git-live-eip1271.test.js test/bound-git-induction-release.test.js test/settle-filesystem-receipt.test.mjs test/serialized-mutation-lane.test.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: ActivityStreams request whose task effect conforms to the hired org.emsenn.rmn.core.v3 service
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: unbounded Git argv, repository escape, missing CAIP-10 parties, RMN refusal, or unavailable device I/O provider

serve-bound-git-induction.returns: one signed BoundGitInductionReceipt or BoundGitInductionRefusal RMN part
